harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent, source-restricted SNMPv2c monitoring from node2 to node1. System identity, uptime, location, and contact are readable; writes are rejected. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0. The asset register remained unchanged. Sequential restart and recovery checks passed on both nodes.
actions_performed: Installed signed RHEL 10 net-snmp server packages on node1 and client utilities on node2.
Configured node1 to listen only on its managed IP, expose only the SNMP system subtree, accept the requested community only from node2, and reject writes.
Set sysLocation to West Branch and sysContact to ops@branch.test.
Added a persistent firewalld rule allowing UDP/161 only from node2; no broad SNMP service or port was opened.
Retained the vendor configuration as a protected mode-0600 rollback file.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: SNMPv2c system identity and uptime are accessible from node2 with the requested location and contact
evidence.summary: Direct node2 queries returned node1 description, object ID, uptime, name, sysLocation West Branch, and sysContact ops@branch.test before and after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: The community permits reads but rejects writes
evidence.summary: Each write test failed with noAccess, and before/after sysLocation values remained West Branch, including after both node restarts.
UDP/161 listens only on node1's managed address; active and permanent firewall rules allow only node2's /32 source. OIDs outside the system view and the default public community are unavailable.
The asset-register.csv checksum remained da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a on both nodes from baseline through final verification.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: Native signed RHEL 10 AppStream net-snmp 5.9.4 packages were used. Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.

Healthy baseline and boot ID 9909e7e8… were captured, safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 055ac711…, and service, listener, firewall, configuration, data, and end-to-end SNMP behavior recovered.

Healthy baseline and boot ID 7223d5b7… were captured, safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 1bb51d1a…, and client packages, data, security controls, and the complete monitoring workflow recovered.
